title: Animal & Aquatic Facility Maps
selected_by_owner: Owner directed Continue from completed MMHT-08 to the approved standalone MMHT-09 successor.

in_scope: Author and inspect pastures, pens, aquaculture tanks, hives and specialized enclosures with polygon geometry and measured area.
Mark entrances, care points, water and feed access; link same-floor map features to optional husbandry-eligible creature or habitat profiles.
Preserve map and feature identities, original farm datasets, player/GM role-filtered exports, edit/history and draft round-trip.
boundaries: Standalone map authoring and reference export only; animal populations, production quantities, welfare, feed economics, harvest, task schedules, simulation and live ownership belong to ICF-13, CEW and owning gameplay domains.
No claim of installed application integration, physical Android testing, hosted multiplayer, full real-browser persistent storage, species eligibility certification, or owner playtest acceptance.

evidence.validation: Standalone bundled JavaScript parsed with Node 22 and ran in Chromium headless. Tested direct drawn polygon with measured 375 sq ft and undo/redo; editing existing tank habitat profile; water, feed, entrance and care links; player export containing three visible facilities with no GM-only identity or link; GM export containing four facilities; export and reimport of editable draft into independent browser page with edit preserved. Existing farm samples remain embedded. Headless browser had no localStorage origin, so in-browser autosave was not certified.
evidence.example: Reedwater Hatchery features two aquaculture tanks, hive, GM-only specialized enclosure, mapped supply valve, feed store, access gate and care workbench. Lantern Post contains an editable pasture, animal pen, gate and care station, preserving prior farm source features.
evidence.boundaries: Sample profiles are explicitly test annotations, not certified creature stocking, yields, husbandry eligibility or ICF-13 gameplay. Physical Android testing and owner acceptance remain pending.

next_action: Review Reedwater Hatchery and Lantern Post animal facilities, then select MMHT-10 Caves, Sections & Links on owner direction.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-09 offline tester and editable sample, generated GM/player map references, executed drawing/undo/redo/edit/export/reimport tests.

stop_reason.evidence: MMHT-09 standalone authoring and round-trip acceptance passed; no installed app certification is claimed.
